assessments.summary: The proof correctly uses the midpoint theorem to show that the medial triangle has linear scale factor 1/2 relative to ABC and hence area 1/4 of ABC. Each corner triangle likewise has two adjacent side lengths halved with the included angle unchanged, so each has area 1/4 of ABC. Therefore all four triangles have equal area.
scopeQualifications: The conclusion is stated for a nondegenerate triangle ABC, so ordinary unsigned areas are positive and the angle/area formulas apply directly.
The proposed future Lean formalization is not part of the proof and is not required for validity.
